dedupe_resolutions.notes: Apple's U.S.-only map label is another implementation consequence of the existing Lake America federal-name event. It is incorporated into the stable record rather than counted as a separate presidential action; Trump's post remains evidence only that he published the claim.

The September 2 retail launch converts the earlier design approval into implemented official distribution. The record preserves the March approval as background without creating a separate current entry for each announcement.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.
Both records arise from the U.S.-hosted G20 meetings but document distinct formal proposals: light-touch AI governance and trade responses to non-market export distortions.
